name: When is the best time to consider a multigenerational home addition?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to consider a multigenerational home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to consider a multigenerational home addition is typically when you anticipate or experience a change in your family's living situation, such as an aging parent needing care, adult children returning home, or a desire to consolidate living expenses. It's also a good consideration if you have available property space and are looking for a long-term housing solution that supports family proximity while maintaining individual privacy. Planning ahead allows ample time for design, permitting, and construction without immediate pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a multigenerational addition when family living situations change, or if you seek long-term housing solutions that offer both proximity and privacy.
